replies.author: @RemoteEarthJourneys
replies.text: There are layers of backup, but none is unlimited. Household tanks come first, public rain tanks sit behind them, and in severe droughts ships have brought drinking water and desalination equipment. The hard part is that there is no airstrip, so even emergency help still has to cross the sea.
